agreed on a date by elimination over four days.
printed something I could have shown on a phone.
felt more like a real plan.
had someone over for one evening. nice, easy, no aftermath.
lost twenty minutes to a map of somewhere I'm not going.
given my one screen-free evening and a whole empty day I go a long way inward — I come out somewhere quite different from where I started, and not where I'd planned to be.

muted one group and un-muted another. net zero.
walked the long way home and didn't check my phone.
made a playlist for a thing that hasn't been planned yet.
booked the haircut I've been putting off since spring.
the stretches where there were people in the house constantly are the ones where I got most done and felt steadiest all year. I'd have bet money against that.
measurably. it's the thing I've been most wrong about.
left a voice note instead of typing. felt strange.
cleaned the kitchen instead of answering anything.
skimmed the invites and closed the tab.
